lines.text: Habakkuk calls the LORD from everlasting and says His eyes are too pure to look upon evil.
Habakkuk says men are like the birds of the air, and the foe pulls them up with a hook.
The foe burns incense to his fishing net, and Habakkuk asks if he will keep slaying nations without mercy.
Habakkuk says he will stand in the temple courts, and the LORD tells him to write the vision on tablets.

wrong_details.true: at his guard post on the ramparts

lines.text: The LORD says to wait for the vision because it will surely come, and the righteous will live by faith.
